title: Some properties of Besov-Morrey type spaces
summary: This paper considers Sobolev-Morrey and Besov-Morrey spaces. For Morrey spaces, multipliers are studied, and a theorem on multipliers from M_p^lambda(T) to M_p^lambda(T) is obtained for 1 < p < infinity and 0 <= lambda < 1/p. Based on this result, embeddings between Besov-Morrey and Sobolev-type spaces are established, namely B_1^alpha(M_p^lambda) embedded into W^alpha(M_p^lambda) embedded into B_infinity^alpha(M_p^lambda) for 0 < p <= infinity, 0 <= lambda <= 1/p, and alpha in R. In addition, an interpolation theorem for Besov-Morrey spaces is proved.
